fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant left a blue scooter bearing registration number TN-30-XX-1087 near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex and could not find it later. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-10-07, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-04 at about 01:20. The complainant, Harish Mani, provided the contact number 9000000132. A person named Sanjay Gopal, associated with the number 9000000073, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Vignesh Balan (9000000105) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scooter reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
